workflow: Sending WhatsApp order confirmations and shipping updates to customers manually
trigger: Customer places an order or order status changes to shipped
current_workaround: Merchant manually copies order details and sends WhatsApp messages one by one from their phone
consequence: Time wasted, delayed notifications, missed updates, poor customer experience, risk of losing orders

workflow: Verifying COD (Cash on Delivery) orders via WhatsApp before dispatching
current_workaround: Merchant manually messages each COD customer on WhatsApp to confirm the order is genuine
consequence: High rate of fake COD orders, wasted shipping costs, manual effort to chase customers, delayed fulfillment

workflow: Sending abandoned cart recovery messages via WhatsApp manually
trigger: Customer adds items to cart but does not complete checkout
current_workaround: Merchant manually copies customer phone numbers from Shopify and sends WhatsApp reminders
consequence: Lost sales, low recovery rate, manual effort is unsustainable at scale, customers forget to complete purchase

workflow: Managing WhatsApp Business API approval and template compliance
trigger: Merchant wants to send automated WhatsApp messages through an app or integration
frequency: once (setup) but recurring issues with template rejections and number bans
current_workaround: Merchant submits templates manually, waits days for approval, reworks rejected templates, or uses personal WhatsApp number risking ban
consequence: Delays in launching automated messaging, frustration, lost revenue, risk of permanent WhatsApp number ban

workflow: Dealing with duplicate WhatsApp notifications from multiple Shopify apps
trigger: Customer receives multiple WhatsApp messages for the same order event (e.g., confirmation + shipping)
current_workaround: Merchant tries to disable notifications in one app or manually deduplicate by turning off features
consequence: Customer annoyance, unprofessional brand image, merchant confusion, wasted API costs

workflow: Paying high monthly fees for WhatsApp integration apps on Shopify
trigger: Merchant needs to connect WhatsApp to Shopify for automated messaging
current_workaround: Merchant pays $10–$50/month per app, often needing multiple apps for different functions (notifications, marketing, support)
consequence: High operational cost, app switching, feature gaps, no single affordable solution covers all needs

workflow: Manually exporting customer phone numbers from Shopify to use in WhatsApp broadcasts
trigger: Merchant wants to send bulk WhatsApp messages (promotions, updates) to customers
current_workaround: Merchant exports CSV from Shopify, copies phone numbers, and uploads to WhatsApp broadcast list or third-party tool
consequence: Time-consuming, error-prone, data privacy risk, no real-time sync, manual list management

workflow: Handling customer support inquiries that come through WhatsApp alongside Shopify Inbox
trigger: Customer sends a support message via WhatsApp instead of Shopify Inbox
current_workaround: Merchant manually switches between WhatsApp and Shopify Inbox, copies conversations, or misses messages
consequence: Fragmented customer history, slow response times, missed messages, poor customer experience
